meaning:
1) to scrape, scrape off, cut off
1a) (Hiphil) to scrape

elsewhere.note: He shall cause the inside of the house to be scraped all over. They shall pour out the mortar that they scraped off outside of the city into an unclean place.
In the four corners of the court there were courts enclosed, forty cubits long and thirty wide. These four in the corners were the same size.
